Completely show the full body of the character in T-pose. Standing upright, facing forward. Arms raise horizontally at shoulder height. Palms facing down, remove handheld objects but keep hand-worn equipment and accessories. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Keep natural body proportions and anatomy. Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, a Korean American woman in her late thirties, the dependable tight end who does a bit of everything: tall, sturdy and square-shouldered with strong arms and solid legs, light tan skin, a neat chin-length straight black bob with a fringe, rectangular sports glasses held on by a strap, a level, no-nonsense look and a small firm closed-mouth smile, wearing sky blue sneakers. She wears exactly the same kit as the character in image[1] (plain white short-sleeved jersey, plain mid grey shorts, dark charcoal grey socks) and is made in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, surface texture, level of detail, lighting and background as image[1], but is a completely different person: a different face, skin colour, hair, age and body, with no moustache, no bald head and no wrinkles, and a sturdy woman's figure rather than a thin one. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
